selection: Strict key allowlists for interaction, stage, browser frame/ref, route-category and EventTiming data. Unknown keys or string enums fail closed.
omitted: Request URLs, selectors, headers and bodies
verification: Known original project identifiers and private input/execution paths were checked absent from all published payloads, including decompressed projection. Metric source excerpts contain code and route patterns, not original fixture values.
claimLimit: Scoped artifact review, not a general secret scan or repository security audit.
